name: Aim High and Find a Way
definition: We aim for jaw-dropping results and work backwards. Goals are often set to what seems possible within existing conditions. We have the courage to aim high and then embrace/force/drive/propel any change necessary to deliver the 'wow.'

terms.label: aim high and find a way

rows.situation: When the goal is being set
rows.under: Sets what the current system can already deliver and calls it a target.
rows.justRight: Sets what would be jaw-dropping for the customer, then works backwards to what has to change.
rows.over: Sets a number nobody believes, and the team stops treating goals as real.

rows.situation: When the conditions make the goal impossible
rows.under: Accepts the conditions as fixed and lowers the goal.
rows.justRight: Treats the conditions as the thing to change, and goes and changes them.
rows.over: Breaks working constraints that existed for a reason in order to hit a number.

rows.situation: When the plan only gets to half the goal
rows.under: Ships the half and reports progress.
rows.justRight: Says out loud that the plan does not reach the goal, and keeps looking for the step change.
rows.over: Rejects every incremental gain while waiting for a step change that never arrives.

rows.situation: When nobody has done it before
rows.under: Treats the absence of precedent as proof it cannot be done.
rows.justRight: Finds the closest thing anyone has done, and works out what is genuinely new.
rows.over: Ignores every precedent and repeats mistakes other people already paid for.

rows.situation: When the goal will scare the team
rows.under: Softens it until it sounds achievable, and nobody stretches.
rows.justRight: States it plainly, with the reason it matters and the first step that is real.
rows.over: Repeats the ambition without ever funding it, until ambition becomes a word people ignore.

rows.situation: When the ambitious bet lands short
rows.under: Hides the shortfall, or restates the goal after the fact.
rows.justRight: Reports what landed against what was aimed at, and what was learned that is worth the gap.
rows.over: Punishes the miss so hard that the next goal is set safe.
